content: Anatumi Wambu Dupwa Mende Pyakana Lao Letamo

content.text: Kamongo, api embena tembole anda dokona sukusa eparape?
Api embenayuu kyau poo pyasi Sayone dokona kingi lala eparape?
Akali mende Anatupa rape rape lao pyuo
rolae doko anjuku lao pyuo karo
pii angi nyera kinyi dupwa iki lao karenge dopale doko.
Wambu yango dupwa kilya kando laa nao
banya puu dupwa kopetame pyuo pisa nao
parali maki dupwa kando dopande piralyamo lao nembo nembo minyuo lao pali nange.
Anatumi awa nange dupwa baame nakama epe kanda nange.
Dopa pipyamopape Kamongo rape rape lenge dupwa baame ketae pyambungi.
Baame piru lengenyili pyuo kaeya nao
Bange mailyamo dokona mende konda pyuo nyipulinya suu pyaa nao mailyamo dolapoko range nyingi.
Wambu koo pii nange dupwa kando wambu lapome bange jeramaŋa wambu lapo kando pii kyatepa pyuo lakana lenge dokona lakami nange.
Yulu doo letamo dusipa piramo wambu doko range kame pyuo minyarasa pira.
